scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof supplied with explicit Kac-Rice normalization and conditional jet limit; standalone checks are supplementary, not certificates of infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: Only complex circular Gaussian white noise and Gaussian windows
Claims for point-intensity Palm maxima, not the global maximum of a large region
Threshold h applies to squared spectrogram height; the double limit varies the squeeze at order \(h^{-1/2}\)
Fixed nonzero squeeze result holds for b held constant with h to infinity
No non-Gaussian, arbitrary-window, multidimensional or joint-point assertion
Independent validation not performed; historical priority provisional
scientific_scope: Palm-normalized local maxima of Gaussian white-noise spectrograms in one time-frequency dimension, analytic Bargmann-Fock coordinates, and determinant-one Gaussian-window dilations; exact curvature law and high-squared-height conditioned curvature crossover.
title: Curvature statistics and a Rician squeeze crossover at high Gaussian spectrogram peaks
